title: Plastics
metaDescription: JourneyLite and Dr. Kurtis Martin offers unmatched experience and excellence in plastic surgery and body contouring in Ohio/Kentucky/Indiana!
excerpt: JourneyLite and Dr. Kurtis Martin offers unmatched experience and excellence in plastic surgery and body contouring in Ohio/Kentucky/Indiana!
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
For more than a decade, JourneyLite has provided the highest quality care to plastic and reconstructive surgery patients.  We offer procedures such as:

  • Arm lift
  • Breast implants
  • Breast lift
  • Breast reduction
  • Brazilian butt lift
  • Blepharoplasty
  • Body lift
  • Brow lift
  • Chin implant
  • Face lift
  • Fat grafting
  • Liposuction
  • Mommy makeover
  • Neck lift
  • Post-bariatric surgery procedures
  • Rhinoplasty
  • Thigh lift
  • Jaw line contouring
  • Lip lift

We also have one of the most experienced plastic surgeons in the midwest on our staff, Dr. Kurtis Martin!

Kurtis Martin, MD

Dr. Kurtis Martin

Plastic Surgeon

Board-certified with more than 26 years of experience, Kurtis W. Martin, MD is widely respected and offers his patients the highest level of skill and artistry for plastic surgery in the Cincinnati and Greater Ohio area. Dr. Martin obtained his undergraduate and medical degree from the University of Kentucky in Lexington. He graduated with his B.S. in Biology with Distinction in 1982 and with his M.D. with Distinction in 1986. he also serves as an Associate Professor of Clinical Plastic Surgery at the University of Cincinnati. Renowned for achieving natural, long-lasting results using modern rejuvenation techniques, Dr. Martin understands that plastic surgery is an art and a science that should bring out your individual beauty and enhance your confidence. His humble and friendly demeanor combined with his masterful skills will provide you with an unparalleled experience. Dr. Martin is Board Certified by the American Board of Plastic Surgery. In his spare time, Dr. Martin enjoys spending time with his wife of over 30 years and their beautiful family. He loves nature and being outdoors. If you are looking for the highest quality plastic surgery in the Cincinnati and Greater Ohio area, look no further than Kurtis W. Martin, MD.

For more information go to CincinnatiPlasticSurgery.com.
